note: Driven through the BINARY on a real pseudo-terminal, because AC-11.6's subject is gated on IsTerminal and no other test in this estate can reach it -- organize_default_declaration.rs names that gap in its own module doc. The harness is self-controlling: a pty that failed to present a terminal makes the binary take the no-tty branch and every assertion reds naming the refusal, so there is no separate harness test. WHAT THE ROW DOES NOT COVER, stated rather than left to be noticed: the per-step byte gate (organize::gate) is not exercised here -- this fixture's held removals are stopped by the ESTATE-wide precondition gate, which is a different mechanism, and AC-11.6's parenthetical about matching shas belongs to the other one.
